newsitem.title: CANADA: StatsCan survey sees May unemployment at 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: StatsCan survey sees May unemployment at 9.5 pct.

text.p: A Statistics Canada survey of analysts forecast Canadian unemployment would show a slight drop to 9.5 percent in May from 9.6 percent in April.
The survey also forecast that consumer prices would rise in May by 1.7 pct from a year earlier.
The survey forecast gross domestic product rising 0.4 percent in May from April.
The economists also forecast merchandise exports for May at C$23.8 billion, and imports of C$21.1 billion.
The agency on average surveys 17 economists each month.
